svg.title: RobotBaseSixAxisMotionPlanner architecture — latest 4K dark cyan edition without background grid
svg.desc: Six plain C# planning algorithms, their class inheritance, controller inputs and outputs, and the Unity main-thread and worker-search boundary. Solid arrows show flow; dashed lines with hollow triangles show inheritance.
svg.text: UPDATED ARCHITECTURE / ADAPTIVE GOAL + CACHED SEARCH
Unity controller · Adaptive goal selection · Six reusable C# planners
Start / B / via poses; rig + analytical IK
Start and via poses remain strict
Optional: exact B invalid? Try nearby poses.
Selected pose feeds all six; B marker is preserved.
World: queries, limits, costs, progress, cancel
Result: joint path, iterations, failure details
Adaptive B: pose offsets + sample count
Abstract C# · shared trees + bounded route refinement
Common TryPlan(), validation, sampling, joint distance, and route scoring
Solid arrows: control / data flow • Dashed connectors + hollow triangles: inheritance
IK, Physics, clearance + adaptive goal validation
Cartesian Arc; visuals, labels, playback + replay
Adaptive fallback yields between main-thread batches.
RRT-Connect / PRM / Informed RRT* + Grid A*
Exact swept-edge cache per joint-space search
Queued World calls → Update() scene queries
Grid: full-robot route checks → retry / accept
Chosen endpoint checked; pose offsets / samples reported.
Exact goal first · Adaptive fallback preserves clearance · 4K / 3840 × 2160
